# Plant mutation tables Each mutation is checked independently. Several mutations can occur in a single check. Base chances below are for mutation severity 1; higher severity can trigger the same mutation more than once.
Stat mutations favor increases below their adjustment range and decreases above it. Values within the range can move in either direction. These ranges guide the direction of adjustment; they are not hard limits on the resulting stat.
